article.story: Iowa State (5-5) at UCF (5-5), Nov. 20 at 6 p.m. EST. Opening Line: UCF by 2.5. Against the spread: UCF 6-4, Iowa State 4-5-1. How to watch: Fox Sports 1 Key stats UCF Offense Overall: 354.2 yards per game (92nd in FBS) Passing: 217.2 yards per game (79th) Rushing: 137.0 yards per game (97th) Scoring: 28.4 points per game (63rd) UCF Defense Overall: 380.0 yards per game (88th in FBS) Passing: 243.1 yards per game (118th) Rushing: 136.9 yards per game (58th) Scoring: 26.0 points per game (85th) Iowa State Offense Overall: 398.3 yards per game (51st in FBS) Passing: 206.9 yards per game (91st) Rushing: 191.4 yards per game (27th) Scoring: 30.4 points per game (47th) Iowa State Defense Overall: 394.8 yards per game (108th in FBS) Passing: 220.7 yards per game (82nd) Rushing: 174.1 yards per game (104th) Scoring: 27.3 points per game (96th) Iowa State ranks 112th in third down percentage, converting 34.6% of the time. UCF ranks 108th on defense, holding its opponents to 42.0%. UCF ranks 13th in the FBS averaging 40.5 penalty yards per game. UCF is 77th in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 85.0% of trips. Iowa State's red zone offense ranks 3rd, scoring on 96.7% of red zone opportunities. UCF is 112th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 28:23, compared to Iowa State's 42nd-ranked average of 31:15. Team leaders UCF Passing: Keyone Jenkins, 1,181 yards, 11 TDs, 4 INTs, 67.8 completion percentage Rushing: Duke Watson, 596 yards on 94 carries, 3 TDs Receiving: Josh Derry, 708 yards on 52 catches, 4 TDs Iowa State Passing: Jaylen Raynor, 1,901 yards, 13 TDs, 6 INTs, 59.8 completion percentage Rushing: Aiden Flora, 1,335 yards on 185 carries, 12 TDs Receiving: Jamal Polite Jr., 389 yards on 20 catches, 2 TDs Last game UCF lost 26-13 to Arizona State on Nov. 14. Alonza Barnett III led UCF with 257 yards on 21-of-30 passing (70.0%) for one touchdown and no interceptions. Landen Chambers carried the ball seven times for 54 yards and scored one touchdown, adding one reception for four yards. Derry had seven receptions for 137 yards. Iowa State beat Cincinnati 41-13 on Nov. 14. Raynor led Iowa State with 229 yards on 14-of-23 passing (60.9%) for one touchdown and one interception. Flora carried the ball 28 times for 216 yards and scored three touchdowns, adding four receptions for 38 yards. Cameron Pettaway had two receptions for 76 yards and one touchdown. Next game UCF plays at Colorado on Nov. 28. Iowa State hosts Kansas State on Nov. 28.
